messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 detected — EU-west inference pool high latency. Root id 1769005555. Page sent to primary oncall. Metric snapshot: 95p latency 4.2s (baseline ~0.4s), error-rate +1.8% on `/v1/predict`. Affected: gpt-small-quantized (eu-west).

jin: taking this now — jumping into logs and autoscaler. quick ask: do we want an immediate status page "investigating"?

alex r: yes please. put "Investigating — increased latency for EU customers". I'll look at GPU utilization + queue depth.

maria (support): We'll need a short customer blurb and localized send times. For enterprise customers we have dedicated contacts — should we DM them directly after the status page goes live?

samira: propose flow: 1) status page -> investigating now for EU (send immediately), 2) NA customers get notice at start of their business day (08:00 PT) unless they are impacted (then send immediately), 3) APAC notice scheduled for 09:30 JST local day if not impacted; if impact in their region we send immediately. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

jin: sounds sensible. For triage: I'll put a short typed status now and we can paste translated blurbs below. Also note handoff window: current oncall ends at 02:00 UTC, next oncall @oncall-rotation — please prepare a handoff note.

incident-bot: Reminder: runbook links: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-spike|latency spike runbook> and incident template: `/scripts/inc-update.sh`.

alex r: quick findings: autoscaler scaled 0->2 slower than expected; there are signs of a slow GC churn in the serving process logs. Sending clipped logs in thread.

alex r: ```
[2026-03-15T09:12:03Z] serve.c::KVCacheEvict - evict 12 entries, mem high
[2026-03-15T09:12:08Z] runtime.c::GC - pause 0.72s
[2026-03-15T09:12:40Z] autoscaler.c::scale - requested 4 nodes, provisioned 1 in 90s
```

jin: ok that explains tail latency. For communications: short English template + translations. Keep them tight, 1-2 sentences. I'll paste proposed copies below.

jin: EN (for status page / general customers): "We're investigating increased latency impacting text generation in EU-west. Engineers are investigating and we will update within 30 minutes. No action required from customers right now."

jin: FR (fr-FR): "Nous enquêtons sur une augmentation de la latence affectant la génération de texte en EU-west. Nos ingénieurs analysent la situation et nous publierons une mise à jour dans 30 minutes. Aucune action n'est requise de votre part pour le moment."

jin: ES (es-ES): "Estamos investigando un aumento de latencia que afecta la generación de texto en EU-west. Nuestros ingenieros lo están analizando; compartiremos una actualización en 30 minutos. No se requiere acción por su parte."

jin: JP (ja-JP): "EU-west のテキスト生成で遅延が発生しているため、調査中です。エンジニアが対応中で、30分以内に更新をお知らせします。現時点でお客様側での対応は不要です。"

maria (support): these are great — for enterprise email we should add a line: "If you experience production errors or degraded performance, reply to this message and we'll prioritize a direct notification."

jin: added enterprise suffix: "Enterprise customers: if your production traffic shows errors or degradations, reply to your support contact and we will escalate for a direct notification."

samira: scheduling table (local sends) — please confirm these conversions before we post: 
- EU (CET/CEST): immediate post at 09:14 CET (now) — send translated FR + EN.
- NA (PST/PDT): scheduled at 08:00 PDT (local start-of-day) unless they are in impacted map (none currently impacted in NA) — send EN + ES at 08:00 PDT -> corresponds to 15:00 UTC.
- APAC (JST/AEST): scheduled at 09:30 JST local for routine notice -> corresponds to 00:30 UTC next day; if APAC impacted send immediately.

samira: note: for email send we need to stagger to avoid support surge: EU immediate, NA wait 30m if no impact, APAC schedule for morning.

nadeem (sales): heads up — I'll ping our top-5 customers in EMEA directly after the status update. Do we want a short separate blurb for high-touch customers?

maria (support): yes, use this high-touch template (DM / email) — short and personal. Example: "Hi <CustomerName>, we're aware of higher latency for the EU region and are investigating. Your instances X,Y are not reporting errors, but if you see issues reply and we'll open a dedicated escalation channel."

jin: operational checklist for posting:
1) Post "Investigating" on status page (English + FR fallback).
2) Trigger incident-bot `status:update` with locale flags. Example command:
```bash
# post investigating status to statuspage API
curl -X POST https://status.redwood.ai/api/v1/incidents 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STATUS_API_KEY' 
  -d '{"impact":"investigating","regions":["eu-west"],"notes":{"en":"We\\'re investigating...","fr":"Nous enquêtons..."}}'
```
3) Send enterprise emails to on-file contacts (maria to execute).
4) Post internal summary to #incidents with translated blurbs (jin).
5) Reassess at +30m update window.

alex r: I'll include quick mitigation steps in the follow-up: force-GC offload and warm a new node pool, plus a temp autoscaler policy to reduce provisioning latency. If that works we can post "partial mitigation" update.

oncall-rotation: I'm accepting handoff at 02:00 UTC. Please leave a short handoff note with: current hypothesis, mitigations attempted, next steps, watch metrics (95p latency, queue depth, provision time). Also include contacts for infra and compute.

jin: Handoff note (to drop into rotation): "Hypothesis: GC churn + slow provision causing queueing -> tail latency. Actions taken: forced GC tuning on 2 nodes, requested 3 warm nodes, updated autoscaler min to 3, posted investigating status page. Next steps: validate 95p latency, confirm new nodes provisioned and warmed, monitor error rate. Escalate to infra if provision >120s. Contact: alex r (infra), maria (support)."

maria (support): I'll queue enterprise emails to send after the status page goes live. For the translations we will send FR to FR accounts and EN fallback.

jin: final note — please react with :thumbsup: when status page post is live and when emails have been queued. I'll monitor and post the +30m update.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident channel created. Post ID: INC-20260315-045. Auto-updates enabled every 15m.

alex r: going to apply mitigation now.

maria (support): queued enterprise sends for EMEA list (5 customers). DMing the high-touch templates to @nadeem for review.

nadeem (sales): reviewed, OK to send after status page. I'll coordinate any 1:1 outreach.

jin: thanks team. leaving a pinned checklist in the thread. I'll update in 30m with metric delta and whether we can mark as "mitigated" or "monitoring".
